entities.name: Juan Felipe Ibarra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Juan Felipe Ibarra was an Argentine soldier and politician. He was one of the caudillos who dominated the Argentine interior during the formation of the national state, 
and ruled the province of his birth for decades.
